messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — nightly e2e perf gate turned red. p95 for mixedseq is up ~28% vs baseline. Can someone kick a rerun and maybe bisect? cc @Mia

ci-bot: nightly/e2e mixedseq FAILED. metric: p95=420ms (baseline 328ms). failing test: longseq-mixedseq-smoketest. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/48720

Mia: grabbing logs now. Any recent runtime deploys in the last 2 hours?

Ravi: I merged #4028 (attention-cache tweak) ~40m ago. Could be related. No obvious regressions locally on short-seq tests but longseq hasn't been exercised as much.

Jen: I'll queue a rerun on the same commit and a build with #4028 reverted. Starting both now.

Jen: commands I'm running:
```
./ci rerun --job nightly-e2e --build 48720
./ci run --job nightly-e2e --commit HEAD~1 --tag revert-4028
```

Sam: thanks. If rerun passes we still should A/B with old kernels; if it fails again, start a bisect.

Ravi: adding a quick tag to isolate KV-cache warmup path in the test harness, and I'll pull perf traces from node-gpu-07 (noticed higher mem use).

Mia: rerun queued by Jen — job 48721. ETA ~12m. Ping me if you want warmup toggles or to force cold starts. :rocket:

ci-bot: rerun job 48721 started. logs/artifacts at https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/48721

Jen: rerun finished — FAILED. p95=430ms on job 48721. kicking revert candidate build 48722 on HEAD~1.

Sam: please attach flamegraphs and perf traces when they arrive. If revert passes, we should revert #4028 and then bisect smaller changes to confirm.

Ravi: collecting perf data from node-gpu-07 now (perf, nvprof, tcptrace). will upload to the artifacts bucket.

Mia: created an incident note: docs/internal/incidents/2755554321-mixedseq-p95.md and linked the builds. keeping this thread as the coordination center.

ci-bot: revert build 48722 completed — PASS. p95=330ms (within baseline).

Sam: looks like #4028 is the likely culprit. I'll open a revert PR and schedule a canary rollback. Thanks everyone for the quick runaround.

Jen: opened PR #4071 to revert #4028 and kicked a canary job. Will monitor dashboards and post results.

Ravi: once canary is green I'll run a focused bisect across the attention-cache changes to find the minimal bad patch.

Mia: nice work team. I'll update the incident doc and transition to a postmortem if we confirm root cause. :white_check_mark:
